note: Per-day validity against the stopping rule frozen in the task file. A day is counted only if it carries usable coverage of both sessions. Days are never repaired, back-filled or spliced; an incomplete day is excluded and the collection simply runs longer.
rule_reference: at least 15 distinct trading days; at least 2 distinct front-contract expiries; both main and evening session represented on at least 10 of those days

days.reason: collector started at 22:07 MSK; the day was already almost over. Start-up fragment, not a covered day.
an 8.7-hour interruption swallowed the whole main session; 56 records against roughly 6000 expected. Cause: host sleep, compounded by transient URLError backoff. Excluded from the cohort.

remediation: collector restarted 2026-08-07 under `caffeinate -i`, which holds the host awake for the life of the process. Storage layout unchanged, so the restart introduces no schema discontinuity.
policy: No day is spliced from fragments. If the host sleeps again, that day is excluded and the end date moves. The stopping rule is not weakened to fit the calendar.
